name: Aplasia of Lacrimal and Salivary Glands
aliases: Congenital Aplasia of Lacrimal and Salivary Glands

criteria.description: Clinical evidence of severe dry eyes (keratoconjunctivitis sicca) and dry mouth (xerostomia) from birth or early infancy
Imaging studies (MRI or ultrasound) demonstrating absence or aplasia of lacrimal and major salivary glands
Exclusion of acquired causes of gland hypofunction such as autoimmune diseases or infections
Histopathological confirmation if biopsy performed showing absence of glandular tissue

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of clinical dryness symptoms plus imaging confirmation of aplasia and exclusion of acquired causes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily clinical supported by imaging; genetic testing may be considered if syndromic features present.

pathognomonic.notes: Severe dryness of the eyes from birth
searchTerms: lack of eye moisture since birth

pathognomonic.notes: Marked dryness of the oral mucosa due to absent salivary secretion

pathognomonic.symptomName: Absence of lacrimal and major salivary glands on imaging
searchTerms: missing tear and saliva glands on scan
no tear and salivary glands seen on imaging
absence of major glands in head scans

common.notes: Due to chronic ocular surface dryness
Due to dryness and mucosal fragility

occasional.symptomName: Difficulty speaking due to dry mouth
searchTerms: trouble talking due to dry mouth

rare.symptomName: Secondary bacterial infections of oral mucosa
Facial asymmetry due to gland aplasia
searchTerms: uneven face due to missing glands
one side of face smaller from gland aplasia

laboratory: Reduced or absent salivary flow on sialometry
Normal autoimmune serologies (e.g., negative anti-SSA/SSB antibodies)
imaging: MRI or ultrasound showing aplasia or absence of lacrimal and major salivary glands
other: Histopathology demonstrating absence of glandular tissue if biopsy performed

distinguishingFeatures: Involvement of multiple ectodermal structures beyond glands
Characteristic hair, nail, and dental abnormalities

redFlags: Severe corneal ulceration risking vision loss
Failure to thrive due to feeding difficulties
